scope: offline replay of saved context assembly; no new retrieval, reranking or answer generation

methods.selected_blocks: Replay saved positive-score chunk order and relevant_block_ids, retaining only selected source ranges.
methods.whole_chunks: Use the same positive-score selected chunks and order, retaining every source range in each chunk.
methods.neighbor_blocks: Use the same selected chunks and block decisions; add at most one preceding and one following source range within each selected chunk, in source order.

limits.budget_unit: Python Unicode characters of quotes; matches saved production assembly
limits.reference_tokenizer: cl100k_base; quote-text tokens only, not provider usage or total prompt tokens

metrics.primary: macro recall of frozen gold quotations on questions with positive quotation labels
metrics.coverage_rule: A gold quotation must be wholly contained in one retained source range from the correct document, with whitespace normalized on both strings. This is literal evidence availability, not semantic correctness.
secondary: all gold quotations present per question
gold quotation group recall (all citations for a required key)
nonempty context on questions with no positive gold labels (descriptive, not a correctness score)
metrics.selection_timing: one local replay per method; excludes historical model calls, retrieval and generation; no performance superiority claim

selection_rule: For this fixed replay, compare primary coverage first, then lower quote-only reference-token count when coverage is equal. Any positive-label question with less coverage must be disclosed; do not silently replace the product strategy.
invalid_or_missing: Keep every suite question in the report. Preserve failed answer statuses. Report cases without saved reranking as not_replayed; never substitute trace drafts for final answers.
constraints: No model API calls, downloads, reindexing or paid requests.
Do not edit frozen inputs, scoring labels, .env, product defaults or resume.
Use identical saved candidates, ranking scores and budgets across methods.
No gold labels may be used to select or order context.
No parameter search, extra budget sweeps or selective reruns.
neighbor_blocks is bounded context expansion, not a complete small-to-parent retrieval experiment.
Small Agent-authored labels are not independent human evaluation or production answer accuracy.
